items.title: Baxter (BAX) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Q2 Beat And Higher Targets
items.summary: Baxter International is back in focus after the fair value estimate in one widely used model moved from US$21.54 to US$27.29, a change of about 27% that feeds directly into updated price target discussions. Analysts are linking this shift to fresh views on earnings execution, segment performance and medium term growth visibility after the latest Q2 results and guidance. As you read on, you will see how to track these changing views and what to watch as the Baxter International story develops...
